title: Source disconnect
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/sources/disconnect, application/json: the adapter no longer reaches one collection. The collection's items are marked disconnected, not deleted, so a work item already taken in from one keeps its link. It is signed with the adapter's access key as definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401; definitions.schema.json has the replay rule. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

collection_ref.description: The ref of the collection, as source-collections.schema.json listed it.

reason.description: Why: removed, the collection is gone from the source or from the adapter's reach; ended, the source's connection to the adapter ended; paused, the source suspended the adapter's access, which may resume.
